facts.fact: Daily Nation reports that Kenya has published a 2025-2030 implementation roadmap, developed under the Ministry of ICT and the Digital Economy, for the 'previously launched' national AI Strategy; the strategy's own launch date is not given, so the article's publication date is used.

systems.system: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Strategy and its Implementation Roadmap 2025-2030
systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and the Digital Economy

note: No body or funding is stated for the strategy: the ministry is named as author only, and funding is mentioned only as a risk to sustain.
